title: cost-hint-scorer + quant-clustering-runner: guided defaults generator
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Introduce Cost Hint Scorer service (offline) that produces tenant-aware recommended defaults for batching, cache TTLs, and quantization profiles. Add Quant Clustering Runner to group model variants and generate candidate quant profiles for evaluation.
description:
Motivation: Customers with heterogeneous workloads still have to manually tune batching, cache defaults and quantization choices. This PR adds an offline analyzer (Cost Hint Scorer) that produces ranked configuration hints per tenant/workload and a companion Quant Clustering Runner that groups model signatures to suggest candidate quantization profiles.

What this PR changes: the change is intentionally split into two cooperating components: 1) services/cost_hint_scorer - a stateless offline scorer that ingests workload telemetry snapshots and replay traces to compute per-tenant cost/latency tradeoff curves and produce a small set of ranked 'hints' (batch_size, kv_cache_ttl, quant_profile_id) with estimated unit cost and expected P95 impact; 2) tools/quant_cluster - a CLI and pipeline that clusters model activation signatures (sequence length distribution, attention pattern fingerprints, activation histograms) and emits quant profile candidates (8-bit symmetric, 4-bit groupwise, mixed-int8) along with a compact regression estimator for expected accuracy loss.

Design notes: the scorer is conservative by default: it prefers safer defaults (smaller batch, longer cache retention) when telemetry indicates high cold-start variance. Hints are exported as JSONL and can be loaded by the defaults-as-code service. The quant clustering step is independent of tenant routing; it outputs labeled clusters that map to recommended baseline quant profiles and associated safety scores. Both components are feature-flagged and run as offline jobs in the econ tooling pipeline.

Backward compatibility & rollout: runtime behavior is unchanged until a tenant opts into experiments. We added a dry-run exporter and a small API endpoint to preview suggested defaults in the Console (feature flag: econ.hint-preview). The feature is gated behind a rollout flag and will be enabled for small cohorts only; there's no automatic enforcement.

Testing & validation: unit tests for scorer heuristics, integration tests that run a 10k-sample replay against a staging runtime image and compare predicted vs observed P95 deltas, and an end-to-end simulation that replays tenant traces through suggested defaults and validates cost delta within a tolerance. Performance tests ensure the offline scorer completes a tenant snapshot (100k requests) within ~3 minutes on a 4-CPU job.

Operational notes: added lightweight telemetry (histogram metrics) and traces to the scorer; alerts configured for pipeline failures and for divergence between predicted and observed metrics beyond 15%. Documentation: new RFC and Console preview docs under docs/rfc/cost-hint-scorer.md and docs/console/econ-hints.md.

Files touched (high level): src/services/cost_hint_scorer.py, tools/quant_cluster/runner.py, tools/quant_cluster/README.md, infra/jobs/cost-hint-pipeline.yaml, docs/rfc/cost-hint-scorer.md, docs/console/econ-hints.md, tests/unit/test_cost_hint.py, tests/integration/test_quant_cluster_e2e.py, small runtime integration shim at runtime/defaults_loader.py.

changelog_entry: Add offline Cost Hint Scorer and Quant Clustering Runner to produce tenant-focused batching/caching/quant defaults; Console preview and RFC included.
testing_summary: Unit + integration + e2e replay based tests included. Offline scorer validated against historical traces; CI perf-smoke verifies processing time target. Added deterministic seeds to clustering tests to avoid flakiness.
rollout_plan: Stage 1: enable econ.hint-preview for 1% of tenants (QA cohorts) and monitor predicted vs observed metrics for 72h. Stage 2: expand to 10% if divergence < 10%. Stage 3: enable suggestions in Console as non-enforcing defaults. No automatic runtime changes without explicit opt-in. Alerts: econ.hint-pipeline-failure and econ.prediction-drift configured in SRE channel.
operational_notes: Pipeline runs under econ-worker queue. Added Prometheus metrics: econ_hint_jobs_total, econ_hint_prediction_error, quant_cluster_job_duration_seconds. Recommended retention: 30d for job traces. Note: cluster runner may use up to 8GB RAM for histogram aggregation on large model fingerprints.
notes_for_release: This is a tooling/ops feature - inform SRE and Solutions Engineering that Console preview is available behind feature flag. Recommend a dry-run with 2 customers before broader rollout.
